title: Solar Array Drive Mechanism Jitter during Sun Tracking
description: Solar array gimbal mechanism encountered motor step skipping during high-rate slew, resulting in 12% drop in array power generation.
symptoms: Current mismatch of 3.4A between wing +Y and wing -Y
Minor attitude disturbances on roll axis (0.08 deg)
root_cause: Increased mechanical friction in drive gear bearings due to cold thermal soak following extended eclipse.
evidence: TEL-1102 - Solar array gimbal motor current spike to 2.1A
LOG-044 - Gimbal drive step slip detected on axis 1
resolution: Applied supplemental drive motor heater cycle and modified slew step rate profile.
lessons_learned: Pre-heat gimbal drive assemblies for 15 minutes prior to egress from eclipse.
document_content: INC-001: Solar Array Drive Mechanism Jitter. Subsystem: POWER. Gimbal step skipping caused 12% power dip. Root cause: Gear bearing cold soak. Resolved with heater cycle.

title: Reaction Wheel 3 Bearing Micro-Vibration & Speed Excursion
description: Reaction wheel RW-3 experienced sudden motor current elevation and acoustic vibrational harmonics affecting fine optical imaging.
symptoms: Wheel speed fluctuated by +/- 150 RPM around setpoint
Attitude pointing jitter exceeded 0.05 deg on pitch axis
root_cause: Lubricant redistribution breakdown across high-speed ball bearings after continuous unidirectional operation.
evidence: TEL-2098 - RW-3 current jumped to 1.8A
LOG-089 - AOCS pointing jitter alarm asserted
resolution: Commanded wheel speed reversal cycle to redistribute bearing grease reservoir.
lessons_learned: Schedule mandatory periodic wheel speed reversal exercises every 45 mission days.
document_content: INC-002: Reaction Wheel 3 Bearing Vibration. Subsystem: ATTITUDE. Speed fluctuation and jitter caused by lubricant breakdown. Resolved with wheel reversal exercise.

title: S-Band Transponder Carrier Frequency Drift
description: Ground station reported intermittent loss of carrier lock and 4.2 kHz frequency offset on primary S-band downlink channel.
symptoms: Downlink SNR fluctuated between 8.5 dB and 14 dB
Ground receiver sweep failed on initial pass
root_cause: Temperature coefficient drift in local oscillator crystal due to degraded thermal blanket insulation.
evidence: TEL-3105 - Transponder baseplate temperature reached 48°C
LOG-112 - Demodulator lock dropouts on ground station pass
resolution: Adjusted ground receiver tracking bandwidth and tuned thermal trim heater deadband.
lessons_learned: Include oscillator thermal drift calibration table in ground station pass scripts.
document_content: INC-003: S-Band Transponder Frequency Drift. Subsystem: COMMUNICATION. Carrier frequency drift caused by oscillator overheating. Resolved by widening ground receiver tracking window and tuning heater.

title: Thermal Radiator Loop Freezing during Prolonged Safe Mode
description: During safe mode attitude drift, passive radiator panel faced deep space cold sink for 6 hours, dropping fluid loop below minimum operational limit.
symptoms: Radiator outlet temperature reached -42°C
Thermal loop flow rate decreased by 40%
root_cause: Safe mode sun-pointing attitude left radiator permanently shadowed with secondary survival heaters unpowered.
evidence: TEL-4019 - Thermal loop thermistor TH-4 reached -42°C
LOG-138 - Fluid loop viscous drag warning
resolution: Autonomous FDIR energized backup survival heater string and biased spacecraft attitude by 10 degrees.
lessons_learned: Survival heater auto-assertion must have highest priority in flight software safe mode rules.
document_content: INC-004: Thermal Radiator Freezing. Subsystem: THERMAL. Radiator temperature dropped to -42C during safe mode. Root cause: Attitude shadow. Resolved with survival heater activation.

title: Payload Optical Detector Overheating during Calibration Slew
description: Optical detector focal plane assembly temperature exceeded operational limit during lunar calibration maneuver.
symptoms: Detector temperature rose from -20°C to +18°C in 25 minutes
Sensor dark current noise degraded image dynamic range
root_cause: Sun shield baffle grazed solar limb angle during rapid attitude transition.
evidence: TEL-5100 - Focal plane thermistor FP-TEMP reached +18.4°C
LOG-170 - Payload thermal warning threshold exceeded
resolution: Aborted calibration slew, commanded spacecraft to anti-sun quarantine attitude, and enabled thermoelectric cooler (TEC).
lessons_learned: Enforce automated keep-out sphere constraints in ground mission planning software.
document_content: INC-005: Payload Optical Detector Overheating. Subsystem: PAYLOAD. Detector heated during calibration slew due to solar graze. Resolved by returning to anti-sun orientation and TEC boost.

title: Main Bus A Transient Undervoltage on Transmitter Key-Up
description: High-rate X-band scientific transmitter power-on generated a 1.8V bus dip, triggering spurious under-voltage alerts on avionics.
symptoms: Main Bus voltage dropped from 28.1V to 26.3V for 12 milliseconds
FDIR logged transient bus anomaly
root_cause: Large inrush current caused by uncharged input filter capacitors on transmitter power supply.
evidence: TEL-1145 - Peak inrush current measured at 24.5A for 15ms
LOG-195 - Bus voltage transient alarm
resolution: Implemented soft-start command sequence for transmitter DC-DC converters.
lessons_learned: All high-power transmitters must include soft-start inrush current limiters in flight software macro.
document_content: INC-006: Main Bus Transient Undervoltage. Subsystem: POWER. Transmitter inrush current caused 1.8V dip. Resolved with soft-start power-up macro.

title: Battery Temperature Increase Associated with Temporary Power-Load Spike
description: Battery pack temperature increased from 28°C to 36.5°C over a 15-minute window following an unexpected payload bus current elevation.
symptoms: Battery current increased from nominal 15.5A to 18.9A
Battery cell temperature climbed at +0.65°C/min
FDIR power subsystem advisory triggered
root_cause: Unexpected secondary payload science heater remained latched in active mode concurrently with X-band downlink transmission.
evidence: TEL-4821 - Battery current measured 18.7A (expected 15-17A)
TEL-4830 - Battery cell temperature reached 36.5°C
LOG-220 - Bus current step increase detected
LOG-223 - Battery thermal threshold warning asserted
resolution: Ground operations executed load shed of secondary science heater. Battery current dropped to 15.8A and temperature returned to nominal baseline (+27°C) within 25 minutes.
lessons_learned: Implement interlock logic in flight software preventing simultaneous science heater activation during high-rate RF transmission.
document_content: INC-007: Battery Temperature Increase Associated with Temporary Power-Load Spike. Subsystem: POWER. Symptoms: Battery current rose to 18.9A, temperature reached 36.5C. Root cause: Science heater latched active simultaneously with X-band downlink. Resolution: Load shed executed, load returned to nominal, temperatures stabilized. Lessons learned: Implement heater/transmitter interlocking logic.

title: Star Tracker Optical Stray Light Blindness
description: Primary star tracker lost celestial tracking lock for 18 minutes while spacecraft traversed high-albedo polar ice sheet reflection.
symptoms: Valid attitude quaternion flag dropped to zero
IMU gyro propagation error accumulated to 0.18 degrees
root_cause: Earth limb albedo light entered optical baffle exceeding threshold for star centroid identification algorithms.
evidence: TEL-2201 - Star tracker background noise count rose 300%
LOG-241 - Star tracker loss of lock event
resolution: Autonomous AOCS transitioned to redundant Star Tracker B mounted on opposite cant angle.
lessons_learned: Update albedo rejection filtering algorithms and baffle glare threshold parameters.
document_content: INC-008: Star Tracker Stray Light Blindness. Subsystem: ATTITUDE. Optical blinding from Earth albedo caused loss of lock. Resolved by autonomous switchover to Star Tracker B.

title: X-Band Antenna Gimbal Cable Wrap Harness Tensioning
description: High Gain Antenna (HGA) azimuth drive stalled at +185 degrees azimuth during Earth tracking pass.
symptoms: HGA drive motor current spiked to 1.9A limit
Downlink signal dropped by 18 dB due to pointing misalignment
root_cause: Thermal contraction of coaxial RF cable harness bundle stiffened flexible loop at low temperatures.
evidence: TEL-3310 - Azimuth drive position stationary at 185.2 deg
LOG-280 - HGA tracking position deviation alarm
resolution: Commanded antenna unwrapping slew in reverse direction and activated harness heating patch.
lessons_learned: Incorporate azimuth cable wrap unwinding logic before any ground pass that crosses the 180-degree boundary.
document_content: INC-009: X-Band Antenna Gimbal Cable Wrap. Subsystem: COMMUNICATION. HGA azimuth drive stalled at +185 deg due to cold cable bundle stiffness. Resolved by reverse slew unwrapping and harness heater.

title: Heat Pipe Non-Condensable Gas Bubble Blockage
description: Avionics bay heat pipe thermal conductance degraded by 35%, causing localized hot spot near central processing unit.
symptoms: CPU junction temperature climbed to 68°C under nominal 50% computational load
Heat pipe condenser end remained colder than expected (18°C)
root_cause: Accumulation of non-condensable hydrogen gas generated by slow internal chemical reaction at pipe wall.
evidence: TEL-4112 - Thermal gradient across heat pipe reached 22°C (nominal < 5°C)
LOG-305 - Avionics thermal margin threshold reached
resolution: Temporary throttling of CPU clock speed from 200 MHz to 100 MHz, followed by thermal soak cycle that drove gas bubble into reservoir slug.
lessons_learned: Require high-purity ammonia working fluid verification and titanium-alloy passivation for flight thermal units.
document_content: INC-010: Heat Pipe Non-Condensable Gas Bubble. Subsystem: THERMAL. Heat pipe conductance dropped 35%, CPU heated to 68C. Resolved by CPU throttling and thermal soak maneuver.

title: Magnetorquer Polarity Command Inversion
description: Magnetic momentum unloading sequence resulted in unintended angular momentum buildup instead of desaturation.
symptoms: Reaction wheel RW-1 speed climbed from 3500 RPM to 4800 RPM in 40 minutes
Attitude control error increased on yaw axis
root_cause: Sign convention mismatch between ground planning software geomagnetic field model and onboard flight software frame.
evidence: TEL-2405 - Reaction wheel momentum vector accelerating toward upper limit
LOG-330 - Momentum management error threshold asserted
resolution: Aborted desaturation sequence, zeroed magnetorquer currents, and uploaded sign correction patch to flight software table.
lessons_learned: Enforce automated coordinate system verification testbench in mission planning software releases.
document_content: INC-011: Magnetorquer Polarity Command Inversion. Subsystem: ATTITUDE. Desaturation caused momentum buildup due to geomagnetic sign error. Resolved by stopping sequence and patching flight software table.

title: Battery Cell Charge Imbalance during Eclipsing Phase
description: Battery pack cell 4 demonstrated lower open-circuit voltage compared to sibling cells, triggering battery management system warning.
symptoms: Cell 4 voltage was 3.82V while cells 1-3 were 4.10V at end of charge
Battery effective capacity dropped by 7%
root_cause: Cell balancing bypass resistor circuit had high contact resistance due to mechanical solder fatigue.
evidence: TEL-1280 - Cell delta voltage exceeded 250mV limit
LOG-365 - Battery cell imbalance alarm
resolution: Reconfigured charge regulator to trickle-charge regime and enabled extended passive balancing duration.
lessons_learned: Monitor individual cell differential voltages at every charge termination cycle for early trend detection.
document_content: INC-012: Battery Cell Charge Imbalance. Subsystem: POWER. Cell 4 delta voltage 250mV due to balancing resistor contact resistance. Resolved by trickle charge and extended passive balancing.

title: Packet Loss Excursion on Downlink Buffer Overflow
description: Downlink packet error rate reached 8.2% and telemetry packets were dropped during bulk memory playback dump.
symptoms: Missing frame sequence numbers in ground station ingestion
Packet transmission delay climbed to 2.4 seconds
root_cause: Flash memory read DMA controller flooded internal packet multiplexer buffer faster than serializer output rate.
evidence: TEL-3450 - Packet buffer depth reached 100% capacity
LOG-412 - Telemetry packet drop count incremented by 148 frames
resolution: Throttled bulk science playback transfer rate and introduced flow control pacing in flight software telemetry engine.
lessons_learned: Set hardware flow control rate ceilings 20% below maximum physical link throughput.
document_content: INC-013: Packet Loss on Downlink Buffer Overflow. Subsystem: COMMUNICATION. High packet drop rate caused by memory playback DMA burst. Resolved with telemetry pacing throttling.

title: Thermal Louver Blade Jamming in Open Position
description: Passive bimetallic thermal louver assembly remained stuck open when spacecraft entered cold orbit phase, chilling battery compartment.
symptoms: Battery pack temperature plunged to +2.5°C (lower operational limit +5°C)
Battery internal resistance increased by 18%
root_cause: Micrometeoroid debris particle lodged in blade hinge pivot clearance.
evidence: TEL-4301 - Battery temperature below red limit threshold
LOG-450 - Low thermal margin alert on battery bay
resolution: Enabled primary and redundant survival heaters to maintain battery within safe thermal envelope (+15°C).
lessons_learned: Install protective debris deflection covers on mechanical thermal louver hinge points.
document_content: INC-014: Thermal Louver Jamming Open. Subsystem: THERMAL. Louver stuck open chilled battery to +2.5C. Resolved by engaging survival heater strings.

title: Thruster Valve Cooldown Anomaly following Delta-V Maneuver
description: Hydrazine reaction control thruster valve temperature failed to cool down after 45-second orbit adjustment burn.
symptoms: Thruster catalyst bed valve body temperature remained at 145°C for 30 minutes
Slight pressure decay in propellant line manifold
root_cause: Thermal soakback from catalyst bed chamber through mounting bracket conductively warmed valve seat.
evidence: TEL-2615 - Valve temperature telemetry above nominal post-firing envelope
LOG-488 - Propulsion thermal soakback advisory
resolution: Oriented spacecraft to position thruster cluster in deep space shadow, accelerating radiative heat rejection.
lessons_learned: Incorporate thermal soakback cooling durations into mission maneuver sequences before closing branch isolation valves.
document_content: INC-015: Thruster Valve Cooldown Anomaly. Subsystem: ATTITUDE / PROPULSION. Valve remained hot due to catalyst bed soakback. Resolved with deep-space radiative cooling orientation.

title: Shunt Regulator Unit Thermal Dissipation Saturation
description: Sequential shunt regulator overheated when spacecraft was in high solar irradiance perihelion with minimal payload load.
symptoms: Shunt regulator heat sink temperature rose to 58°C
Excess power dump capability reduced
root_cause: Excess solar array generation with all battery strings fully charged and science payloads unpowered.
evidence: TEL-1390 - Shunt stage 3 thermistor in high yellow band
LOG-522 - Shunt regulator dissipation warning
resolution: Offset solar array sun-pointing angle by 25 degrees (off-pointing slew) to reduce incident solar power input.
lessons_learned: Automate solar array off-pointing algorithms whenever battery state of charge exceeds 98% and payload is idle.
document_content: INC-016: Shunt Regulator Thermal Saturation. Subsystem: POWER. Excessive solar generation dumped into shunt regulator caused heating. Resolved by off-pointing solar array wings by 25 degrees.

title: Radio Frequency Interference on Command Uplink Receiver
description: Command receiver reported high bit error rate (BER) and dropped uplink frames while operating over European ground station.
symptoms: Uplink frame acceptance dropped from 99.8% to 62%
Receiver automatic gain control (AGC) indicated high out-of-band power
root_cause: Terrestrial radar installation operating near 2.0 GHz band generated harmonic intermodulation distortion.
evidence: TEL-3610 - Receiver AGC voltage saturated at 4.2V
LOG-560 - Command frame CRC checksum errors recorded
resolution: Switched uplink communication carrier to alternate assigned frequency channel and increased ground EIRP by 3 dB.
lessons_learned: Maintain active coordination database of known terrestrial radar transmitters along orbital ground tracks.
document_content: INC-017: Command Uplink RF Interference. Subsystem: COMMUNICATION. High BER on uplink due to terrestrial radar intermodulation. Resolved by channel frequency switch.

title: Multi-Layer Insulation (MLI) Blanket Delamination
description: Localized MLI foil flap delaminated near propulsion bay during launch ascent or thermal cycling, altering surface emissivity.
symptoms: Propellant tank skin temperature showed higher day/night temperature swings (+/- 14°C)
Tank heater duty cycle increased by 22%
root_cause: Acoustic vibration during stage separation degraded hook-and-loop fastener stitching.
evidence: TEL-4450 - Propellant tank temperature diurnal swing exceeded specification
LOG-601 - Tank heater duty cycle increase logged
resolution: Re-tuned heater control setpoints to accommodate altered thermal emissivity and maintain propellant above freezing point.
lessons_learned: Implement reinforced stitching patterns and metallic clips for MLI outer layers near high-acoustic areas.
document_content: INC-018: MLI Blanket Delamination. Subsystem: THERMAL. Damaged insulation increased propellant tank temperature swings. Resolved by re-tuning heater duty cycles.

title: Fiber Optic Gyro Scale Factor Thermal Drift
description: Inertial measurement unit Z-axis gyro exhibited non-linear drift rate during spacecraft thermal equilibration.
symptoms: Attitude determination residual error grew to 0.35 degrees over 3 orbits
Reaction wheel rate dampening jitter increased
root_cause: Thermal gradient across optical coil spool caused differential Sagnac phase shift bias.
evidence: TEL-2720 - IMU Z-axis rate bias diverged from Kalman filter estimate
LOG-640 - Attitude estimation residual threshold warning
resolution: Applied polynomial thermal bias correction model to flight software AOCS estimator.
lessons_learned: Calibrate optical gyro temperature coefficients across full -20°C to +50°C thermal vacuum spectrum.
document_content: INC-019: Fiber Optic Gyro Thermal Drift. Subsystem: ATTITUDE. Optical gyro Z-axis drifted due to spool thermal gradient. Resolved by applying polynomial temperature calibration model.

title: Battery Thermal Runaway Precursor during Fast Charging
description: During high-rate battery recharge following deep eclipse, battery thermal slope accelerated unexpectedly, mimicking thermal runaway precursor.
symptoms: Battery temperature reached 39.1°C with +1.2°C/min slope
Current was 19.4A at 28.8V terminal voltage
FDIR warning FDIR-PWR-001 tripped
root_cause: Combined internal Joule heating and high solar irradiance on adjacent radiator face during fast charge phase.
evidence: TEL-4821 - Current peaked at 19.4A
TEL-4830 - Temperature spiked to 39.1°C
LOG-223 - Thermal threshold alarm asserted
resolution: Autonomous FDIR curtailed charge rate to 8.0A taper mode. Operators subsequently performed load shed of secondary payloads. Temperature stabilized to 29°C within 18 minutes.
lessons_learned: Enforce dynamic temperature-dependent charge current limits (C/5 maximum when temp > 33°C).
document_content: INC-020: Battery Thermal Runaway Precursor. Subsystem: POWER. Battery current peaked at 19.4A and temp reached 39.1C during fast charge. Autonomous FDIR tapered charge current to 8A and load shed was commanded. Resolved within 18 minutes.
